detailEntry: Actual active element recorded, commonly BODY after full-page detail navigation. No modal/dialog is rendered; focus containment is neither implemented nor appropriate for these route pages.
returnAssessment: No automatic restoration to the invoking row is claimed. Browser/in-app return preserves all list data. Tab/Enter reaches visible named controls, including Back to Payouts; Space activates native summary and buttons. BODY focus after route replacement is a non-blocking navigation observation under this runner, not a modal focus violation or keyboard trap. It remains an explicit improvement opportunity for SA review.
visibleFocus: Keyboard traces record :focus-visible and computed outlines at interactive targets. Route BODY focus has no claimed visible indicator.
escape: Native details disclosure is not dismissible/modal; Escape leaves it open. Space/Enter toggles it. Detail is a page with Back control, not a sheet; no Escape-close promise applies.
noTrap: 100 consecutive Tab traversals recorded at each width in the Settings fixture Payouts overview, plus long expanded-list Tab traversals and successful Back activation. Users can reach shell navigation and return controls.
refresh: Identifier integration records same activity detail identity after hard refresh; full list preservation is asserted only for Back without hard reload.
